purpose: Reference delivery lifecycle; the executed agreement and accepted project plan determine applicable gates.

stages.name: Handoff
stages.gate: Handoff brief accepted by the delivery team

stages.name: Mobilize
stages.gate: Project Charter delivered and signed off

stages.name: Analyze
stages.owner: capture-requirements; map-journey when needed; refine-backlog before each sprint on agile engagements

stages.name: Build
stages.owner: the configured project implementation workflow; plan-sprint for each sprint on agile engagements

stages.name: Deploy
stages.gate: Go-Live Acceptance issued (deemed-acceptance clock per the SOW clause)

stages.name: Closeout
stages.gate: Hypercare Closeout delivered (lessons and asset harvest complete)
